## Published Denver cost context

- Exterior house painting: about $1.55 to $4.10 per square foot of paintable surface (2026 published Denver data)
- Interior painting: about $1.50 to $3.50 per square foot
- Kitchen cabinet refinishing: about $2,000 to $8,000 per kitchen; replacement commonly $15,000 to $30,000+

## Colorado conditions that affect paint

- UV increases roughly 10% per 1,000 meters of elevation (World Health Organization); Denver sits near 1,600 meters
- Denver average last spring freeze about May 5; average first fall freeze about October 7 (National Weather Service, Boulder)
- Average first measurable snow about October 18; latest recorded spring freeze June 8, 2007
- Homes built before 1978 may contain lead paint; EPA Renovation, Repair and Painting rule applies
